welcome.body: Get ready, {name}! 🏖️ Beach Trip 2026 starts tomorrow — your first prompt lands in the morning. Pack your imagination!
welcome.mid_body: Welcome aboard, {name}! 🏖️ Beach Trip 2026 is already underway — you're jumping in mid-trip, and today's prompt is waiting.

farewell.body: That's a wrap on Beach Trip 2026, {name}! 🏖️ You finished {done} of {total} prompts and wrote {words} words. Hope it was a blast — see you next time!

prompts.body: Heading to the beach! What's your favorite thing about travel days?
prompts.subtext: Kick it off great... lots of detail!

prompts.body: Day 1 was lots of travel. What was the funniest thing that happened?
prompts.subtext: Bonus points if someone in the group looks silly

prompts.body: Tell me about something that happened today that was completely unexpected?
prompts.subtext: Accident? Surprise? Hope nobody got hurt!

prompts.body: What's the best thing you've eaten so far?
What's an animal or creature you'd really like to see before you leave?
prompts.subtext: Try to think of one you haven't seen yet.

prompts.body: Last day! What will you remember the most about this trip?
prompts.subtext: Did you see Sam the fish again? Or something else?

prompts.body: Back to reality! What are the 3 things you'll tell your friends?
prompts.subtext: How are you going to describe the trip?
